NetBird has picked up a ton of new features since my last video, so in this guide I walk through my own setup and highlight the biggest additions along the way. We cover Control Center draft mode, deploying a routing peer, NetBird SSH, the new expose command, reverse proxy private services, local MFA, and a look at what's coming next. Everything is open source and self-hostable, and all the links are down below.
